label: non_ocr
name: Non OCR Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR image into exactly one content category based primarily on its visual subject, objects, scene, and composition.

labels.people: A photograph primarily showing one or more people, including portraits, selfies, families, groups, workers, performers, or crowds.
labels.nature: A natural outdoor scene such as mountains, forests, rivers, lakes, oceans, beaches, deserts, waterfalls, clouds, or landscapes.
labels.plants: An image primarily focused on plants, flowers, trees, leaves, grass, crops, shrubs, or other vegetation.
labels.products: A physical item primarily presented as a commercial product, such as appliances, tools, furniture, cosmetics, toys, accessories, or household goods.
labels.vehicles: An image primarily showing a vehicle, including cars, motorcycles, bicycles, trucks, buses, trains, boats, aircraft, or construction vehicles.
labels.food_and_drink: An image primarily showing food, meals, ingredients, fruits, vegetables, desserts, snacks, beverages, or prepared dishes.
labels.architecture: An image primarily showing the exterior of a building or structure, such as a house, tower, monument, bridge, temple, office, or historical building.
labels.interiors: An image primarily showing an indoor space, such as a bedroom, living room, kitchen, office, shop, restaurant, hallway, or decorated room.
labels.medical_imaging: A clinical or diagnostic image such as an X-ray, MRI, CT scan, ultrasound, pathology image, dental scan, or other medical scan.
labels.games: An image primarily showing a video game scene, game character, virtual environment, game object, or gameplay without important readable interface text.
labels.sports: An image primarily showing a sport, athlete, sporting action, sports equipment, playing field, court, track, stadium, or competition.
labels.artwork: An image primarily showing a creative visual work such as a painting, drawing, sketch, sculpture, mural, illustration, cartoon, comic, vector art, digital art, storybook image, or other handmade or stylized artistic composition.
labels.logos_and_branding: An image primarily showing a logo, emblem, symbol, trademark, brand mark, badge, or visual brand identity.
labels.fashion: An image primarily focused on clothing, footwear, jewellery, accessories, makeup, hairstyles, models, outfits, or fashion styling.
labels.events: An image primarily showing an organized event such as a wedding, party, festival, concert, ceremony, conference, celebration, or public gathering.
labels.technology: An image primarily showing computers, electronics, robots, machinery, technical equipment, circuit boards, servers, or devices in a technical context.
labels.graphics: An abstract or designed visual such as an icon, pattern, decorative composition, geometric design, symbol set, background graphic, or non-text diagram.
labels.other: An unclear, mixed, unusual, or unmatched image that does not primarily fit any of the available categories.
